subject: Certification scenario questions & evidence plan for ISO/FedRAMP dry-run
messages:
From: Erin Blake <erin.blake@acmehealth.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acmehealth.com
Date: Mon, 8 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick Q: ISO 27001 roadmap alignment + FedRAMP dry-run window

Hi David / Priya,

Thanks again for last week's demo. As we map our procurement timeline we need to align on a couple of certification items before we move to PO: specifically, (1) an ISO 27001 target date and (2) a FedRAMP-style dry-run (not an actual authorization) so our auditors can validate integration points.

High-level asks: can you share a scenario-based list of evidence we'd be expected to produce (system snapshots, KMS attestation, SOC 2 reports, SIG/CAIQ responses) and an estimated timeline for a dry-run in Q3? Also, if you have a short agenda for a 2-hour dry-run we can review that.

We filed a preliminary intake (HS-5421) with procurement; we need these artifacts to avoid delaying the contract. Can Priya or David confirm owners and whether Redwood can run a pre-dry-run with AuditOps?

Appreciate your help—this will be important for our security committee next Wed.

Best,
Erin Blake
Director, Vendor Risk & Compliance
Acme Health

Attachments: none (initial ask)
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Erin Blake <erin.blake@acmehealth.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, procurement@acmehealth.com
Date: Mon, 8 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick Q: ISO 27001 roadmap alignment + FedRAMP dry-run window

Erin—thanks for the clear ask. High level response below and we will follow up with a short plan and owners by EOD tomorrow.

Quick answers:
- Evidence scope: we typically provide a focused evidence matrix (see attached evidence_matrix_v1.xlsx) mapped to ISO 27001 controls, FedRAMP baselines, SOC 2 controls, and SIG/CAIQ checkpoints. For a dry-run we can prepare snapshot exports, KMS key rotation logs, IAM role usage reports, and a small set of audit traces for the 30-day sample window you prefer.
- Dry-run timing: we can run a pre-dry-run in late July / early August; recommended timeline below (we'll confirm availability):
  * Week 0: evidence handoff & access set-up (2 business days)
  * Week 1: sampling & extraction (3 business days)
  * Week 2: dry-run session(s) with AuditOps (1–2 sessions, 2 hours each)
  * Week 3: findings & remediation plan
- Owners: Priya will drive the evidence handoff; Kimberly will coordinate logs & ops artifacts; Marissa will triage any compliance narrative or control mapping questions.

See attached draft_dryrun_agenda.pdf and the preliminary evidence matrix. One clarification request for you, Erin: what baseline are your auditors expecting for the dry-run (FedRAMP Low / Moderate / NIST 800-53 rev4 vs rev5)? If you can confirm we will tailor the control mappings.

-David

David Kim
Head of Trust & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachments: evidence_matrix_v1.xlsx; draft_dryrun_agenda.pdf
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Erin Blake <erin.blake@acmehealth.com>, AuditOps <auditops@auditors.net>
Date: Tue, 9 Jun 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick Q: ISO 27001 roadmap alignment + FedRAMP dry-run window

Thanks David—adding detail on owners and a couple of scenario questions that will determine the sample artifacts we pull. Quoting David below where relevant.

Scenario clarifications (need Erin/auditor input):
1) Tenant isolation: is the dry-run auditor expected to validate tenant boundary material (network diagrams, VPC peering, routing tables) or will they accept a narrative + screenshots? If they need full snapshots we will need an additional maintenance window to redact customer-specific data.
2) Key management: will KMS attestations and HSM usage logs be acceptable, or will the auditor request operational proofs (e.g., recent key rotation events, KMS access log samples)?
3) Data residency: please confirm which region(s) the auditor will sample for (us-east-1, eu-west-1, etc.).

Owners and immediate asks (internal):
- Priya: compile and deliver the evidence bundle to Erin (link + shared folder) and coordinate access.
- Kimberly: produce the 30-day log export (authn/authz, API gateway traces, KV cache snapshots) and a short readme describing extraction process.
- Marissa: update control narratives for ISO 27001 Annex A mapping and a SIG/CAIQ row for the things we cannot evidence automatically.

I will draft the email to AuditOps to propose dates once Erin confirms baseline and region.

--Priya
Priya Natarajan
Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference

Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick Q: ISO 27001 roadmap alignment + FedRAMP dry-run window 

Erin / AuditOps—thanks for the quick turnaround on the baseline question in your note this morning (FedRAMP Moderate / NIST SP 800-53 rev5). Per that, we've outlined a proposed mutual action plan and attached the updated SIG/CAIQ draft and evidence matrix (sig_questionnaire_acme_v2.docx).

Mutual action plan (proposed):
- June 11: shared folder + temp access provisioned by Redwood (Priya)
- June 14–18: Kimberly to run 30-day exports and provide readme (authn logs, API gateway, KMS audit traces)
- July 26: Pre-dry-run internal review (Redwood only) to rehearse extraction and redaction steps
- Aug 2–3: Dry-run sessions with AuditOps (2 x 2-hour blocks — one technical, one process & narratives)
- Aug 10: Findings recap and remediation plan delivered by Redwood

Notes / constraints:
- Tenancy snapshots: AuditOps confirmed they prefer sanitized snapshots (screenshots + limited exports). Full raw customer data exports will not be requested; we will still need a short maintenance window for safe redaction.
- KMS evidence: AuditOps said access logs + recent rotation events will be sufficient for the dry-run. HSM-level attestation will be a separate ask if actual authorization is pursued.
- ISO timeline: our internal ISO 27001 target remains Q4 2026 for certificate issuance (dependent on successful gap remediation after dry-run). We will document the control mapping deliverables required for your security committee in the shared folder.

Action owners (recap): Priya (evidence handoff + folder), Kimberly (log exports + readme), Marissa (control narratives + SIG/CAIQ gaps), David (exec escalation / schedule).

Erin—please confirm the proposed dates or suggest alternatives. Once you confirm, Priya will send the access link and AuditOps an invite for the Aug sessions.

Thanks—looking forward to getting this scheduled.

-David

David Kim
Head of Trust & Compliance
Redwood Inference
